repos_data.description: MCP server for Google Search Console: 17 read-only tools covering performance queries, quick wins, CTR gaps, cannibalisation, traffic-drop diagnosis and indexing, plus a self-contained white-label HTML SEO audit in English or Italian. Claude Code plugin, .mcpb bundle, Docker.

Google Search Console MCP server for Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, and any MCP client. Query clicks, impressions, average position, URL inspection, sitemaps, and eligible indexing workflows. Run locally with npm or self-host on Cloudflare Workers. Google OAuth, no API keys. By digestseo.com.
Post-publish SEO performance MCP. Unifies Google Search Console, Matomo, GA4, Clarity, and AI-citation signals per URL and emits a per-URL verdict.
